name: Nee, Chanto Shiyou yo! 2
original_name: 姉、ちゃんとしようよっ！2
source:
Sequel to the first game.

One year after the events of the first game, Kuuya Hiiragi finally finished his training at some distant relative's house, the Inugami family.

After so much time, he is finally allowed to go back to the Hiiragi house and live together with his six older adopted sisters who love and dote him.

But little he knew, his two adopted sisters at the Inugami house where he was training himself also loved him, and came after him.

Now Kuuya has eight adopted sisters fighting for him.

[Shortly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=35705]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
前作的续篇。

前作事件过去一年后，柊空也终于在远房亲戚犬神家完成了训练。

离家许久，他终于获准回到柊家，与疼爱、宠溺自己的六位义姐共同生活。

然而，他不知道训练期间在犬神家结识的两位义姐同样爱着他，并一路追了过来。

如今，共有八位义姐要争夺空也。

[简要翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=35705]Getchu.com[/url]]
